facts.business: Cella Space Limited is a company that advanced an unsecured loan of ₹33.27 crore to its wholly owned subsidiary during the year, funded through partial liquidation of fixed deposits, utilization of overdraft facilities, available bank balances, and advances received from Aura Space.
facts.related_party_note: Loan given to wholly owned subsidiary company: During the year, the Company advanced an unsecured loan of ₹33.27 crore to its wholly owned subsidiary. The loan was funded through partial liquidation of fixed deposits (₹16.15 crore), utilization of overdraft facilities against the current account (₹11.66 crore), available bank balances (₹5.46 crore), out of advances received from Aura Space.
